dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Oh, wow... Looks like you're already an expert on Inazuman open-air hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: The temperature of the water, the shape of the stone statues, the trees and flowers around the pool, even the placement of the folding screens... Everything is just perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: You might consider becoming a stakeholder in Aisa Bathhouse... If you choose to invest, we could be business partners!
